name: xhs-agentic-v2
description: 企声发布：单企业与集团自托管的小红书全员营销与GEO内容协作

scripts.check: pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm contracts:check && pnpm build
scripts.contracts:generate: pnpm --filter @xhs-agentic/database... build && pnpm --filter @xhs-agentic/network-security build && pnpm --filter @xhs-agentic/wechat-miniapp build && pnpm --filter @xhs-agentic/api build && pnpm --filter @xhs-agentic/api openapi && pnpm --filter @xhs-agentic/contracts exec openapi-typescript openapi/openapi.json -o src/generated/openapi.ts
scripts.dev:api: pnpm --filter @xhs-agentic/database... build && pnpm --filter @xhs-agentic/network-security build && pnpm --filter @xhs-agentic/wechat-miniapp build && pnpm --filter @xhs-agentic/api dev
scripts.dev:worker: pnpm --filter @xhs-agentic/database... build && pnpm --filter @xhs-agentic/network-security build && pnpm --filter @xhs-agentic/wechat-miniapp build && pnpm --filter @xhs-agentic/worker dev
scripts.fault:worker: pnpm --filter @xhs-agentic/database... build && pnpm --filter @xhs-agentic/network-security build && pnpm --filter @xhs-agentic/wechat-miniapp build && vitest run apps/worker/src/generation-runtime.real-provider.integration.test.ts
scripts.production:audit: pnpm --filter @xhs-agentic/database... build && pnpm --filter @xhs-agentic/network-security build && pnpm --filter @xhs-agentic/wechat-miniapp build && pnpm --filter @xhs-agentic/api build && pnpm --filter @xhs-agentic/api production:audit
scripts.test: pnpm --filter @xhs-agentic/database... build && pnpm --filter @xhs-agentic/network-security build && pnpm --filter @xhs-agentic/wechat-miniapp build && vitest run && pnpm test:scripts
